requests.request_id: ART-0007/Initial assessment and why it was wrong
requests.text: The first assessment pointed upstream, to an interruption in the overnight window. On the evidence available at the time that was the reasonable read: the failure appeared in an overnight batch, the job had no history of reference-data faults, and an upstream interruption would have produced precisely the symptom seen. It was tested rather than assumed, and it did not survive the test — ERP logs show no interruption during the valuation window. That finding is what redirected the investigation from infrastructure to data, and it did so within the same working day. Recording the hypothesis was not the error, and this section should not be read as though it were. Withholding an assessment until it was certain would have left the incident without a working direction during exactly the hours when the close was most at risk. The hypothesis did its job by being specific enough to disprove quickly.

Position update on INC0035338 opened at priority P2 against inventory-valuation. Triage assessment: Overnight ERP outage. Run was overnight batch. The feed is failed. No immediate mitigation yet. Platform running diagnostics now.
